source.quote: The Triangulator's blueprint was obtained from the Lotus in an inbox message, with duplicate blueprints available in the [[Market]]. The resources needed to craft the key were [[Beacons (Prosecutor)|Beacons]] (not to be confused with the [[Gear]] item), which could be obtained from [[Guardsman#Variants|Prosecutors]] in the [[Grineer Shipyard|Grineer Shipyards]] on [[Ceres]]. Prosecutors would drop 1-2 Beacons of one type each, with Delta Beacons being the rarest. The Prosecutor's element did not affect which Beacon dropped.
